1.c4 g6 2.d4 Bg7 3.e4 d5 4.exd5.strategy: Accepts the pawn Black offers and keeps the pawns on c4 and d4 in place. White is a pawn up with the centre intact, and Black has to justify the sacrifice with quick development and pressure on the d4 pawn.

1.c4 g6 2.d4 Bg7 3.e4 d5 4.exd5 c6.strategy: Attacks the pawn on d5 to win it back and open the c-file; if White grabs a second pawn on c6, the d-file opens against d4 instead. The cost is time: only the bishop on g7 is developed, so White gets the first say.
